About Tekila Mexican Grill

Tekila Mexican Grill, located at 2920 Tidwell Rd in Houston, TX, offers a delightful dining experience for anyone craving authentic and flavorful Mexican cuisine. From the moment you step inside, the warm, welcoming atmosphere makes it easy to feel at home. The restaurant exudes a casual yet charming vibe, with friendly greetings from the staff and an energetic environment that sets the tone for a great meal. The décor and lighting are thoughtfully designed to provide a comfortable space for both family dinners and casual nights out with friends.

The food at Tekila is a standout feature, with a menu that brings real depth in spice and seasoning. Every dish, whether it’s a daily special or a classic favorite, showcases the kitchen's dedication to quality and authenticity. The rib plate, which is large enough to share, and tacos are particular favorites, both packing bold flavors and generous portions. The Tex-Mex options, such as the fajita enchilada, are also popular choices for those seeking a mix of traditional and Tex-Mex flavors. For those who appreciate variety, Tekila offers enough options to ensure there’s always something new to try, with large portions that make it worth the visit.

The drink selection at Tekila complements the food experience perfectly. Margaritas and other beverages are well-balanced in flavor and offered at reasonable prices. Whether you're stopping by for a casual drink or pairing it with your meal, the drinks enhance the overall dining experience. Despite being a popular spot, service at Tekila remains attentive and efficient, with staff making sure you’re well taken care of even during busier times.

In addition to its tasty menu and great service, Tekila’s ambiance plays a key role in making it a local favorite. With its lively yet comfortable atmosphere, it’s a place where you can enjoy a satisfying meal with friends and family without feeling rushed or crowded. Whether you’re here for the food, the drinks, or the inviting atmosphere, Tekila Mexican Grill ensures a memorable experience.

Reviews

“ Tekila Mexican Grill on Tidwell feels like exactly the spot you want when you’re craving honest, flavorful Mexican food in a warm, welcoming environment. The moment you walk in, there’s a sense of energy — chatter from neighbors, friendly greetings from staff, a casual but nicely maintained space that makes you want to sit back and enjoy. The food here hits hard on authenticity. Every item we tried had real depth in spice and seasoning. From daily specials to the steady favorites, there’s a strong sense that the kitchen cares about quality, not just filling orders. The menu has enough variety so you never feel stuck — and the portion sizes justify coming back and exploring more. Drinks are a fun part of the experience. Margaritas and other options are neither overhyped nor underwhelming — you get good flavor, fair price, and enough attention from bartenders. Even when the grill gets packed, the service remains coordinated, making sure you’re not left waiting too long. Ambience plays a big role in what makes Tekila stand out. It’s lively without being overwhelming. The décor, lighting, layout, and seating combine to create something genuinely comfortable — great for family dinners, groups of friends, or casual nights out. The staff’s friendliness and willingness to help (speed up orders, adjust things, offer suggestions) rounds out the experience well. There are occasional minor slips — maybe a chip basket that isn’t crisp, or slower service during lunch rush — but they’re far outweighed by how much this place delivers. Five stars for Tekila Mexican Grill: for flavor, atmosphere, value, and enough heart that you feel good dining here rather than just eating. ”

Calvin Bui

“ The rib plate was amazing. Enough for 2 people . Tacos were very good. Cozy atmosphere. Very reasonably priced. ”

D Oz

“ I was in the area and did a search for nearby Mexican food. Found this spot and loved it. Terrific food, great service and clean. Here are pics of enmoladas and a Tex mex fajita enchilada on the side. Delicious! In future I will specifically drive across town just to eat here… ”

James Webster
